excerpt: Semos.ai Manager Agents are AI agents for people managers that learn from meetings to draft feedback and recognition. Free plan; Pro $39, Power $69.
content:
Semos.ai Manager Agents is a set of AI agents for people managers. A Meeting Agent builds context from your meetings, and other agents use it: a Feedback Agent and a Recognition Agent draft messages based on what actually happened, an HRBP Agent helps structure difficult people conversations and their documentation, a Career & Growth Agent prompts growth talks, a Culture Agent flags shifts in team sentiment, and a Company Agent tracks news about your sector. The aim is to point you to what needs attention, such as overdue feedback or recognition you missed, and to explain why each suggestion is made so you learn as you go.

Semos.ai says its guidance draws on Stanford's 4Is feedback framework, the Big Five personality traits and Hofstede's cultural dimensions. Its Product Hunt gallery shows Google Calendar and Outlook Calendar connections and scores for culture, feedback and recognition. There is a free plan with 250 AI credits, paid Pro and Power plans, and an Enterprise mode that adds SAP SuccessFactors and Workday integration, SSO and SCIM.

Semos.ai is part of Semos Cloud, which makes people and culture software for large companies; its privacy policy names the operator as Semos Software LLC, a Delaware company with an address in Lewisville, Texas. The product launched on Product Hunt on 29 September 2026 and finished #5 for the day with 183 upvotes and 33 comments. The makers listed are Ivana Maznevska, Miodrag Stojanov, Jovica Nastovski and Natasha Davidovska.

We have not tested Semos.ai Manager Agents ourselves. This page brings together its official site, pricing page and privacy policy, its Product Hunt launch and the official pricing pages of comparable tools, and says where each fact comes from.

paragraphs: Natasha Davidovska writes that the team spent years building people and culture software for large enterprises at Semos Cloud, and saw that managers lacked practical tools for leading their teams day to day. Manager Agents grew out of that.

She describes it as specialised agents that share one context drawn from your meetings, so the advice is about your actual team rather than generic. It drafts feedback and recognition, helps you prepare for hard conversations, and uses behavioural science to shape how you approach different people.
launch_story.attribution: Natasha Davidovska, maker, on Product Hunt

use_cases: Drafting specific feedback after a meeting
Remembering to recognise good work on time
Preparing for a difficult or underperformance conversation
Planning career and growth talks with direct reports

fit: manage a team and have no HR business partner close at hand
want feedback and recognition drafts grounded in what was said in meetings
want to try an AI management coach on a free plan first
not_fit: need a full performance-review or OKR system: tools such as Lattice cover that
cannot let meeting content go to an AI service: the privacy policy lists LLM providers among its service providers
need HRIS integration on a self-serve plan: SAP SuccessFactors and Workday are Enterprise-only

pricing.intro: Semos.ai's self-serve plans are credit based. Prices are shown with a $ sign; the page does not name the currency. Each plan's credits are described as lasting 30 days.

plans.name: Free
plans.detail: 250 credits for 30 days (about 5-10 'intelligence moments'), full access to the multi-agent leadership AI

plans.name: Pro
plans.detail: 500 credits for 30 days (about 15-20 moments), adaptive coaching, meeting summaries and actions

plans.name: Power
plans.detail: 1,000 credits for 30 days (about 30-40 moments), higher meeting volume, priority access to new capabilities

plans.name: Enterprise Connected Mode
plans.detail: SAP SuccessFactors and Workday integration, SSO, SCIM and AI governance, Google and Microsoft 365 data, company-wide analytics

notes: Extra credits: $15 for 100 more, self-serve plans only. Payments go through Stripe.
The pricing page describes credits in places as 'one-time' and elsewhere as monthly, and the homepage says 'Self-serve, monthly', so check the billing period at checkout.

alternatives.intro: Two like-for-like tools for managers, picked by us. Prices come from each product's own pricing page, checked on 14 October 2026.

items.name: Fellow
items.what: AI meeting notes, 1:1 agendas and action items for teams
items.starts_at: Free; Team $7 per user a month billed annually
items.difference: A meeting assistant first, with notes and recordings, rather than agents that coach you on feedback and recognition.

items.name: Lattice
items.what: Performance, goals and engagement platform with manager tools and an AI agent
items.starts_at: From $4 per seat a month billed annually, $4,000 a year minimum
items.difference: A company-wide HR platform bought by the organisation, while Semos.ai has a free self-serve plan for one manager.

liked: Help for managers who have no HR business partner nearby (a maker's point that others echoed)
asked: Whether it tracks patterns across several meetings over time
Whether it suggests what feedback to give (makers: yes, drafted from your meetings and based on Stanford's 4Is framework)
How sensitive one-to-one meetings are kept private (makers: personal data is masked before it reaches the AI models and data is encrypted in transit)

quotes.text: Does it track patterns across multiple meetings over time ?
quotes.author: Dipanshu Kushwaha

pros: Free plan to try it before paying
Advice is based on your own meetings, not generic tips
Explains why it suggests something, so you can learn from it
Backed by Semos Cloud, which already sells people software to large companies
cons: Credit-based plans; the pricing page is unclear whether credits renew monthly
HRIS integrations and SSO only in Enterprise mode
Meeting content is processed by third-party AI providers
Many of the launch-day questions on Product Hunt were flagged as likely AI-written, so there is little independent feedback yet

x.none: We found no posts about Semos.ai Manager Agents on X apart from the company's own account.

faq.a: A set of AI agents for people managers. A Meeting Agent learns from your meetings, and other agents use that context to draft feedback and recognition, prepare hard conversations, suggest growth talks and flag changes in team sentiment.
There is a free plan with 250 credits for 30 days. Pro is $39 with 500 credits and Power is $69 with 1,000 credits. Extra credits cost $15 per 100. Enterprise mode is priced by sales.

faq.q: Does it suggest what feedback to give?
faq.a: Yes. The makers say it drafts feedback from what happened in your meetings, based on Stanford's 4Is framework, and you edit the final message.

faq.q: How does it handle private meeting content?
faq.a: A maker said on Product Hunt that personal information is masked before it goes to the AI models and data is encrypted in transit. The privacy policy says AI outputs are not used to retrain models unless stated, and lists encryption among its security measures.

faq.q: Which calendars and HR systems does it connect to?
faq.a: Its Product Hunt gallery shows Google Calendar and Outlook Calendar. SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, Google and Microsoft 365 data connections are listed for Enterprise Connected Mode.
Semos.ai is part of Semos Cloud. Its privacy policy names Semos Software LLC, a Delaware company, as the operator.
Fellow for AI meeting notes and 1:1s, and Lattice for company-wide performance and engagement with manager tools.
